How to calculate when converting a jeonse deposit to
monthly rent: Check the conversion cap first

Calculate the conversion amount first
Assuming that 50 million won of a 300 million
won jeonse deposit is converted to monthly rent,

published by the National Law Information

Using a conversion amount of 250 million won,
